text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka achieves a remarkable victory at the Kinko Sho. Afterwards, Air Groove tells her that she has become an ideal for other Umamusume to aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Staking her pride as Empress, Air Groove declares she'll supersede that ideal one day and challenges Silence Suzuka to a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Air Groove and Silence Suzuka decide the ultimate competition between the two of them will take place at the Takarazuka Kinen.
